steps.prompt_exact: Can you build me a little phone-friendly browser file called Meta Tag CTR Card Duel where I can enter a page topic, edit two competing SEO title/description cards, see length meters plus clarity/promise/duplicate-word warnings, pick a winner, and copy or export the chosen snippet?
steps.response_summary: ChatGPT returned one complete offline HTML file for a Meta Tag CTR Card Duel with editable snippet cards, scoring, warnings, winner selection, copy, export, sample data, reset, and local autosave.

Pick Card A or Card B to build the final copyable snippet.

Targets used here: title sweet spot 50–60 characters, description sweet spot 120–160 characters. Treat the warnings as a fast editorial pass, not a search-engine guarantee.
